name: sources
description: Collapsible, numbered list of the sources an AI answer drew on — "Used 3 sources" — whose numbers match InlineCitation

meta.name: Sources
meta.description: Collapsible, numbered list of the sources an AI answer drew on — "Used 3 sources" — whose numbers match InlineCitation

props.name: items
props.description: The sources, in citation order. Each has `title`, `url` and an optional `description`. Only absolute http(s) URLs become links; anything else (e.g. `javascript:`) renders as text.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n). `summary` may contain `{count}`.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Where it lives. Treated as untrusted: only absolute http(s) URLs are linked.

fields.name: description
fields.description: An excerpt or note shown under the title.

examples.title: Answer sources
examples.code:
<Sources
  items={[
    { title: 'Refund policy', url: 'https://example.com/refunds' },
    { title: 'Terms of service', url: 'https://example.com/terms', description: '§4 covers cancellations.' },
  ]}
/>

whenToUse: Listing what an AI answer was based on, below the answer
Giving numbered targets for the InlineCitation markers inside the answer
whenNotToUse: Ordinary navigation links — use List or Link
An agent’s process (searched, read, wrote) — use ChainOfThought

antiPatterns.bad: Rendering model-supplied URLs straight into href
antiPatterns.good: Pass them to Sources / InlineCitation, which only link absolute http(s) URLs
antiPatterns.why: A model can emit javascript: or data: URLs; linking them is script injection

related.name: InlineCitation
related.reason: InlineCitation numbers in the text point at the same rows

related.name: AiBadge
related.reason: AiBadge marks the answer as AI-generated; Sources says what it rests on

intent.a11yRationale: A native <details>/<summary> disclosure (Enter/Space) whose summary states the count ("Used 3 sources"), so it works before hydration and find-in-page can open it. The list is an <ol>, so each source is announced with its number, matching the InlineCitation markers. Refused URLs render as plain text, never as a link that does nothing

content.tone: Use the source’s own title; keep descriptions to a short excerpt

flexibility.note: Do not bypass sourceHref() — model output is untrusted
